title: Two parallel tool events of a coord hook session with no token keep the token of the claim the store granted
goal: coord_hook.renew_if_due and save keep the token a granted claim returned when a parallel tool event of the same session saved its refused claim later (a lock on the session's state file, or a save that keeps a token another event wrote), so a session's presence lease stays renewable and releasable. Found by the SP-fp3hxl6q review (S4, BG-wepc3t4y): the loser's save drops the winner's token, and the lease holds up to 6 h with no one to renew it.

run:
import importlib.util as u,sys
s=u.spec_from_file_location('h','.claude/hooks/coord_hook.py');h=u.module_from_spec(s);s.loader.exec_module(h)
import inspect
src=inspect.getsource(h.save)+inspect.getsource(h.renew_if_due)
ok=any(w in src for w in ('flock','lockf','O_EXCL','merge'))
print('state save guards a parallel event',ok);sys.exit(0 if ok else 1)
